ways.label: SH6 to Blowfly Hut, Māori Saddle Hut and Coppermine Creek Hut

end.name: gate south of the Waita River Bridge
end.quote: a gate just south of the Waita River Bridge

evidence: Walking the Haast to Paringa Cattle Track is a three-day journey and you will need to be prepared to stay in huts along the route.
Access to the north end of the track is signposted approximately 40 km northeast of Haast on SH6 at the Windbag Saddle.
The sound end of the track is marked by a gate just south of the Waita River Bridge about 11 km north of Haast Junction.
It is another two-hour walk to the highway.

doubts: Start ref F2 (unnamed track meeting the highway, east end) chosen from the text's north end near Windbag Saddle; position agrees but not certain. End: text puts the highway two hours past Coppermine Creek Hut; the gate end has no clear feature, ref null. Thompson Creek is the only crossing the text singles out (steep access into a fast-flowing river, needs extreme caution to cross), recorded as a ford. 'sound end' is the page's wording (likely 'south end'). Mataketake Hut reached by Mica Mine Tops Route (about 2 hours from Blowfly Hut) or Māori Saddle Route (10 minutes past Māori Saddle Hut), recorded as side trips.
